final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.zoneref AS z, s.entrystat AS e, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS a FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.z, s1.e, s1.a, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT e, AVG(a) AS a4 FROM s3 GROUP BY e), s5 AS (SELECT s3.z, s3.e, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a - s4.a4 AS d5 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.e = s4.e WHERE s3.a > s4.a4) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(d), AVG(d5) FROM s5
